notes.title: We re Giving Away 300,000 Copies Of Cult Of The Wind
notes.content:
Cult of the Wind [official site] is a third-person multiplayer shooter in which your character casts their arms wide and pretends that they’re an airplane. You need to be moving in order to shoot and you can briefly morph into an actual plane in order to launch yourself short distances. It’s silly and simple and we’re giving away 300,000 copies of it for free below.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Cult of the Wind is RELEASED! - Version 1.0
notes.content:
It took a while, but Cult of the Wind reached Full Release on July 1st! The game is now full-featured and fully playable, with new official maps, a level editor, and Workshop support.

[img]http://www.northofearth.com/misc/cotw_shot.jpg[/img]

You can grab it here:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com//app/293840]STORE PAGE[/url]

And see the new trailer here:
[url=http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vvYRYmiC30Q]TRAILER[/url]

notes.title: Cult of the Wind SOARS to Beta 4 with Mac and Linux support!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.northofearth.com/misc/ars_volatus.jpg[/img]

-Added tentative Mac and Linux builds. May have some issues.
-New map: Ars Volatus.
-Two new clothing items: Combat Boots and Party Dress.
-Updated Skytop and Dry Lock with several fixes.
-Numerous gameplay tweaks.
-Fixed memory leak.
-Added support for Xbox 360 controller on Windows.
-Sun can no longer be deleted.
-Fixed Workshop issues on 32-bit systems.
-Fixed killbox not working on shielded players.

notes.title: Dedicated Server Added!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.northofearth.com/misc/cotw_art_small.jpg[/img]

An official Cult of the Wind [b]dedicated server[/b] is now online. It's located in Newark, New Jersey and runs smoothly. It currently accepts 16 players, but this can be easily increased.

notes.title: Cult of the Wind has come a long way, and there's still a long way to go.
Cult of the Wind has come a long way, and there's still a long way to go.
Cult of the Wind Upcoming Features
notes.content:
Here's a list of things currently in the works:

[list]
[*] Three more official maps plus a finished version of Skytop.
[*] A whole bunch of character options including an actual airplane costume.
[*] Custom voices for characters (including pew pew sounds).
[*] More models and brush types for map-making.
[*] Custom game modes that you define by placing certain objects in a map.
[*] Localization for languages.
[*] Map sharing with Steam Workshop.
[*] Macintosh version.
[*] A demo for Mac and Windows.
[*] Bots for offline play.
[*] Dedicated servers.
[/list]
